note_en: Look at the verb + 得 + result pattern in 小雨被她念叨得受不了 "Xiaoyu was nagged by her to the point she couldn't stand it." Where English needs "so much that" or "to the point of," Chinese simply puts 得 after the verb and then states the result; combined with 被, it also tells you who caused it. 吓得她直接emo了 "it scared her into emo mode" works the same way.
